F1: Split requests are interpolated again by the backend, which can duplicate ad-hoc filters and re-expand variable values.
F2: An expression that becomes empty after interpolation can create an empty group and throw before the observable emits.
F3: Sharded queries can resolve `$__auto` against each time chunk instead of the full range, changing query resolution.
F4: This identifies missing regression coverage, not a separate defect that requires fixing before merge.
